positions.name: AsyncJobContract
positions.frame: how does the async job contract handle dispatch, receipt, and retrieval?
positions.why: All three expressions cohere around the ratified async job contract for `remember`: src-1 states the contract (receipt in seconds, extraction watched by polling a cursor), src-2 asserts its non-blocking and durable properties (no blocking call, no lost work if the receipt is dropped), and src-3 records the key decision that remember dispatches and the agent either polls the run or gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call. The set holds the full arc from contract ratification through its operational guarantees to the dispatch-and-retrieval decision.
